defaults.unexpectedTypeMessage: Please reply with a text message: CONFIRM, RETAKE or STOP.

step1.description: Ask for the odometer photo and wait for it. As a step-finder candidate this is the RETAKE branch — chosen when the driver wants to retake or replace the picture, or says the reading shown is wrong (retake, again, resend, wrong, one more photo, galat hai).
step1.unexpectedTypeMessage: Please send a *photo* of the odometer display — not text, a voice note or a file.

step2.description: Extract the reading from the photo the driver just sent and ask them to reply CONFIRM, RETAKE or STOP as text. A new photo sent here re-enters this step, so resending a picture is itself a retake.

step3.description: Re-ask for a clear answer. Reached when the driver typed something that is neither a confirmation, a retake request nor a cancellation.

step4.description: Record the confirmed reading and send the success message. As a step-finder candidate this is the CONFIRM branch — chosen when the driver agrees the reading shown is correct (confirm, yes, correct, right, ok, save it, theek hai, sahi hai).

step5.description: Acknowledge the cancellation and end the flow. As a step-finder candidate this is the STOP branch — chosen when the driver wants to abandon the odometer capture (stop, cancel, exit, quit, not now, leave it, rehne do).
